parameters.name: X-CorePOS-Event-Id
parameters.description: The `id` of the event. A request sent again carries the same one.

parameters.name: X-CorePOS-Timestamp
parameters.description: When the request was signed, in seconds since the epoch.

parameters.name: X-CorePOS-Signature
parameters.description: `v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the subscription secret, of the timestamp, a dot and the raw body.
